notes:
Kénédougou Kingdom (Sikasso), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Kénédougou Kingdom (1 page); the Kong Empire page is cited in the kong-empire dossier.

The start c. 1650 is the infobox's. Kénédougou was Kong's dependency until its independence in 1825 (the kong-empire dossier carries the vassal pair 1737-1825 at confidence 1). Not on the page: the Minianka conquest year, Babemba's expansion into Burkina Faso and Ivory Coast, the area, the treaty with France (undated), Kong's earlier rule of the region. The Wassoulou dossier calls Samori's siege "April 1887 to the end of the 1888 rainy season"; this page says 15 months. Gazetteer: Bougoula, Minianka (region), Sikasso as a polity centre.
